conceptualAnchor.anchorReference: custody chain ledger for trip-based purchases
conceptualAnchor.realWorldSignal: stamped travel manifests, receipt packets, and settlement trails
conceptualAnchor.whyItFits: The product is about trusted handoffs, order progression, and settlement across customer, traveler, and admin roles.

derivedTokenLogic.surfaceBase: warm paper neutrals with graphite text
derivedTokenLogic.spacingPolicy: compact on admin surfaces, more breathing room in customer and traveler views
derivedTokenLogic.radiusPolicy: restrained by default, not uniformly soft
derivedTokenLogic.motionPolicy: document handoff motion with status transitions that expand into focused detail views

motionPaletteDecision.signatureMotion: compact rows expand into a detail panel when a trip, order, or withdrawal needs attention
motionPaletteDecision.typographicRoleContrast: editorial section headings against compact neutral body copy
motionPaletteDecision.paletteSummary: paper, graphite, teal, ember, and olive

libraryDecisions.decision: Use Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS as the baseline implementation stack.
libraryDecisions.reason: The product needs SSR-friendly customer and traveler flows with strong mobile-first composition.

libraryDecisions.decision: Use Next.js App Router with shadcn/ui on top of Tailwind CSS.
libraryDecisions.reason: The admin panel needs fast composition of operational tables, forms, dialogs, and evidence surfaces.

libraryDecisions.decision: Keep visual language product-specific rather than relying on a generic dashboard kit look.
libraryDecisions.reason: The three surfaces have distinct jobs and should not collapse into one interchangeable shell.

designExecutionHandoff.adminApp: verification, financial review, and exception handling

reviewRubric.renameTest: The UI should not be renameable to another product category without changing composition, palette, iconography, and motion language.
reviewRubric.stateClarity: Every data surface must show loading, empty, stale, and error states distinctly.
reviewRubric.motionFit: Motion must serve handoff and status visibility, not decoration.
